section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1984
title: 12 Accidental Deaths by Sex : Male victims of accidental deaths accounted for 67.3 per cent of the total accidental deaths in the country during 1984 while the female victims were 32.7 per cent. The ratio of male and female victims for the States as a whole was 67.0% and 33.0% respectively while for the Union Territories as a whole it was 76.1% and 23.9% respectively. This percentage of male and female victims for the Metropolitan cities as a whole was 66.2% and 33.8% respectively.
